title: Feed the Aliens - Retro arcade shooting meets sheep farming
author: alltheprivilege
selftext:
Introducing Feed the Aliens!

A side-scrolling arcade alien shooter with a farming twist.   
Defender meets farming sim.  
  
Play it here in your browser!   
[https://noodleonit.itch.io/feed-the-a...](https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUlxb01IYUJvTGxXNDZrOS1rcjkzRzE4c1VSOXxBSTVJdTV2UUNTRllzOC1iYlhBZU05d0t5eE1mdU1EaGRxSnY1VF9WM19lMGtnSmFvWjV2SEdHWEdibzBhS0I0RU9kNHljNl95N3BUOTlYN2pZLXBYNW4xdHIwWUN5WDJCWmpE&q=https%3A%2F%2Fnoodleonit.itch.io%2Ffeed-the-aliens&v=_BTSqq16-Uw)  
  
Fly Darryl's crop-duster biplane around a looping farm world, and take down the saucers with your pea shooter before they beam up the townspeople.   
  
Water the crops and herd the flock so they can eat and make lambs. Keep the aliens content with sheep before they start taking people. Lose all citizens and it's over. Every 7th day, the boss aliens arrive.

Lots of play time spent balancing power ups and difficulty, but let me know thoughts!
